items.body: M3 work stage. Each file must be a regular JSON file. Do not modify tracked source, configuration, credentials, network resources, or external services. After these real artifacts and the focused test result exist, use the available normal drover_work_update tool with action=complete for this run so WorkService can create the separate verification run. Do not claim that this one worker turn is the verification stage. Finish with one Drover-State: done sha=<current 40-character git HEAD> line.
